title: Change Order Terms of Professional Services Projects
content:
Any change to the scope, value or schedule of a Professional Services Projects engagement takes effect only through a change order signed by the authorized contact.

## Terms

1. **Signature.** A change order may be applied only once the client has signed it. Whether it is signed is read from the system record of the change order, its number and its status.
2. **Lapse.** A change order not signed within the class's change order signature period in calendar days lapses.
3. **Effect.** A signed change order changes the contract value by its value change and moves the target completion date as it states. A scope reduction can never take the contract value below what has already been billed.
4. **Administration fee.** The former clause under which the change order administration fee was the class fee for each signed scope or schedule change, waived when the absolute value change was below the class waiver figure, with a pure schedule change with no value change charged the fee, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for change order administration fees.
5. **Growth limit.** The contract value may never exceed the original value multiplied by one plus the class growth limit percentage divided by 100 through change orders; a change that would pass that limit needs a new statement of work.
6. **Class.** Change orders never re-class the engagement.

## Growth limit worked through (hypothetical figures)

An engagement has an original value of 50000.00 and a class growth limit of 35 percent. The highest contract value change orders may reach is 50000.00 multiplied by 1.35, that is 67500.00. A change order that would take the contract value to 68000.00 passes that limit and needs a new statement of work; one that takes it to 67500.00 does not.

## Scope reduction floor (hypothetical figures)

On an engagement with a contract value of 60000.00 of which 42000.00 has already been billed, a scope reduction may take the contract value down to 42000.00 and no lower.

superseded_clauses: The change order administration fee is change_order_admin_fee_usd for each signed scope or schedule change, waived when the absolute value delta is below change_order_fee_waiver_below_usd (a pure schedule change with no value delta is charged the fee).
